Directions: Based on the information below and on your knowledge of physics, answer each question that follows.
Content: Tritium is a radioactive form of the element hydrogen. A tritium nucleus is composed of `text(one)` proton and `text(two)` neutrons. When a tritium nucleus decays, it emits a beta particle (an electron) and an antineutrino to create a stable form of helium. During beta decay, a neutron is spontaneously transformed into a proton, an electron, and an antineutrino.
